data: tests/fixtures/validator: 320px crops of Sammy's comparison image (reference clay head, two clay attempts, the toon attempt, an MHS3 still). Positives: 4 base images x 6 perturbations (shift, scale 1.06, blur 1.6, brightness 1.12, rotate 2.5 deg, JPEG q55). Negatives: 6 pairs of clearly different heads.
findings: contour_px separates best: perturbed copies stay under 4.2 px, different heads start at 9.7 px (256 px frame).
edge_f separates well but is sensitive to blur on low-contrast clay renders (0.65 worst case).
sil_iou separates by only about 0.03 on busts. Kept as a secondary check.
palette detects style (clay vs toon scores 0.01-0.03) but not head shape.
The chat's two clay attempts differ by 0.9 px of outline: the last revision was a tweak, not a fix.
caveats: One reference head, one pose (front), busts not isolated heads, 320 px crops. Re-calibrate on your own renders with calibrate.py before trusting the floors for a new character.
Negatives are different heads, not near-misses. A subtle error (jaw 0.05H too wide) is the head audit's job, not these floors'.
